blocks.text: Tell me a little about the student, what they are studying and where support would help. I will get in touch to talk through the situation, answer your questions and see whether I am the right person to help.

blocks.label: P: I will arrange a free phone conversation with the parent first. If it makes sens
blocks.text: I will arrange a free phone conversation with the parent first. If it makes sense to continue, I will arrange a free Meet & Greet with the student and parent together. It usually takes about 20 minutes and gives us time to talk about the student’s goals, answer questions and let the student get a sense of how I work. After that, take time to decide. If you would like to proceed, message me and I will arrange the first session. Once tutoring is confirmed, Auxesis provides access to the private Auxesis Portal.

blocks.label: P: Based in Ontario, Canada, and working online with students in Canada and interna
blocks.text: Based in Ontario, Canada, and working online with students in Canada and internationally.

blocks.text: Please share only the information that will help me discuss tutoring with you. I do not need the student’s school name or detailed medical information.
